settings.name: Hamza Tariq
settings.title: Majestic architectural center table
settings.content: Absolutely majestic center table. The fluted gold pillars at the four corners give it such an architectural, luxurious look. The black marble surface is heavy and gorgeous with realistic gold and white veins. Came safely delivered in Lahore within 4 days.

settings.name: Dr. Naila Arshad
settings.title: Elevated our entire drawing room
settings.content: We placed this in our main drawing room between our 8-seater sofa set and it completely elevated the entire room. The double-tier storage is very practical for holding coffee table albums and trays. 10/10 craftsmanship.

settings.name: Zubair Ahmed
settings.title: Top-notch quality & secure packing
settings.content: Top-notch quality. I was a bit worried about shipping a marble table to Karachi, but the packaging had thick corner guards and bubble wrap. Perfectly intact. Finish of the gold frame is smooth and matte-brushed.

settings.name: Saira Bano
settings.title: Very solid build & heavy marble
settings.content: Very solid build and lovely aesthetics. Slightly heavier than I expected which is actually great because it doesn't wobble at all on the carpet. Highly recommended!

settings.name: Kamran Farooq
settings.title: Italian luxury look at fair price
settings.content: Gull e Gulzar never disappoints. The fluted pillar detailing looks like high-end imported Italian furniture. The price of Rs. 18,500 is completely justified for this level of quality.

settings.name: Madiha Javed
settings.title: Helpful customer service & stunning table
settings.content: Ordered via WhatsApp after speaking with their team. Very helpful customer service and delivery was on time. The table is stunning in real life!

settings.name: Bilal Siddiqui
settings.title: Flawless finish
settings.content: Everything from the polish on the marble to the sturdy gold frame is flawless. Fits perfectly in our living room.

settings.name: Anam Waqas
settings.title: Beautiful contrast
settings.content: Elegant design and very stable. Beautiful contrast between the dark veined top and the warm gold rods.
